items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Tex Satterwhite, the trombone player was there

ctx.x: Who else was in the band at the time?

Nobody, nobody that… Tex Satterwhite, the trombone player was there but there wasn’t, oh and he had a great guitar player, who was Jimmy Raney’s teacher named Hayden Causey, great guitar player, we used to call him Modak [unsure of spelling] after an elephant that had just escaped from some fair in Illinois, this guy weighed some 300 odd pounds, he was gigantic, but Joe Venuti always kept good guitar players around, ever since he had Eddie Lang and this guy was a monster, he was a wonderful player. A lot of the……

place apart, then! I said who the hell is this kid, he was playing like a kind of, both those guys played kind of a Charlie Christian style, that was the beginning of single string guitar playing then. But they also played good chord stuff, ‘cause that’s what Venuti insisted on. So, and oh Barrett Deems was the drummer.
